race.comment: CARBONARA (6) may not win often, but he is a genuine performer who will close to her peak fitness third up from a spell. In a field of this nature, she deserves plenty of respect and should be fighting out the finish. KILONOVA (4) showed plenty of grit when scoring comfortably by nearly 2 lengths at this track last start, and looks well placed to continue on his winning way. NAVY NINA (8) returns from a 3 -and-a-half-month spell for a new trainer, and she has the ability to make her presence felt fresh, especially if the money comes for her. SILVER SMASH (11) cannot be dismissed and is worth considering in wider top 4 combos.
